neighbours.label: Rights, inclusion and self-determination of people served by care or welfare (self-advocacy, people living with a condition, child participation, integration into society); the same frames on other topics stay quiet.
fire: The program teaches self-advocacy to young adults with disabilities.
Services are designed with people living with dementia and their families.
Youth participation in decisions about care is a right.
Inclusion in regular classrooms should be the default for disabled pupils.
Patients should be empowered to make their own choices about treatment.
The charter calls for full integration of refugees into society.
Consumer groups must be involved in planning mental health services.
Older people have a right to live independently in the community.
quiet: The program teaches welding to young adults in the city.
The sofas are designed with people living in small flats in mind.
Youth soccer in the summer is a big draw.
Tile in small bathrooms should be the default for builders.
Customers should be asked to choose their own seats on the train.
The charter calls for new paint on the buildings in town.
Trade groups must be invited to the annual dinner.
Older cars have a habit of rusting around the wheels.

short: inclusion and rights of care users
notes: Probes: 0.20-0.70 on this topic, under 0.06 on near misses; 'least restrictive environment' read 0.15. The peak token varies, so this is a topic rather than a word.
